calls.title: GrowthBook Demo for voodoo
calls.summary: Voodoo aims to enhance its experimentation and configuration tooling by focusing on user experience and integration flexibility, as they operate across 50 to 100 independent studios. Current challenges include an 85-86% configuration delivery success rate and complex segmentation needs, leading to a call for improved UX for both technical and non-technical users. GrowthBook demonstrates capabilities that align with Voodoo's needs, offering flexible integration, advanced analysis tools, and a focus on gaming-specific features. A two-week enterprise trial is proposed to assess GrowthBook’s UX, while commercial considerations emphasize pricing alignment with Voodoo's budget. There is a mutual exploration of collaboration for custom solutions, particularly in integrating with existing LiveOps tools.
calls.keywords: remote configuration, AB testing, segmentation, meta-analysis, UX improvement, feature flagging
